name: Novira
decision_note: Private investment group of Vít Vrba (Zug/Brno) with about 70% of its capital in real estate and the rest in startups, loans and other investments; it says itself that it is not a VC, so it is a private investor outside the VC pilot.

evidence.quote: Our focus shifts from purely online to strongly physical, with ~70% of capital in real estate and the rest in startups, loans and other strategic investments.
Společnosti již dříve podpořily fondy Reflex Capital Ondřeje Fryce a Novira Capital Víta Vrby.

analyst_notes: Novira (group founded 2007, 'headquartered in Zürich' per the site, Novira Investment AG in Zug; Czech office and companies in Brno - Novira Capital s.r.o., Novira SE, Novira Management, Novira Property, Novira Construction, Novira Finance; ARES) invests the principals' own capital: real estate development and rental (about 70%), startup investments, loans/mezzanine financing and FX operations. Startup track record: Smartlook (sold to Cisco 2023), Shopsys, Reservio, Smartsupp, Survio (merged into a holding, CzechCrunch 2024-10-02, quote e3 from the tag page teaser), Ofisly (Brno, Nov 2023). Typed private_investor (real-estate-dominant group, so E3 would also apply to the group as a whole) and excluded S1. No startup investment dated on/after 2024-10-25 was found, so it would also be inactive as a startup investor (E7) - not separately tested. Note: unrelated to Novira Therapeutics (US biotech).
